title: host0 — hosting for whatever your agent creates
excerpt: HTML, sites, apps with a shared database, Markdown, PDFs — whatever your agent created, live at a link you can share.
content_html:
NewPro is here — remove the badge, keep 30 days of versions. See pricing

Host whatever your agent created

Turn your HTML artifact, website, Markdown, PDF, image, you name it, into a shareable link. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Bot, Hermes and any other agent.

Free plan, Pro from $9/mo. See pricing

Claude · using the host0 skill

Build a standup tracker for our team, then deploy it to host0

On it — writing the app now.

index.htmlapp.jsstore.jsstyles.css

Reply to Claude…

Your agent can build a page, a site or a whole team app in one conversation. Getting it online is still stuck in the big-cloud era. host0 deletes that step — whatever your agent created should be as easy to share as a Google Doc.

How it works

From prompt to a link in one sentence

Connect once, describe the tool, say the word. There is no step four.

  1. 01

    Add the skill

    Your agent grabs the host0 skill — one Bash script, signed in with a link you approve in your browser — and deploys with it. Optionally add host0 as an MCP connector too: it doesn't deploy, but the same conversation can share, lock down, and manage your apps.

    host0.ai/skill.md · mcp.host0.ai/mcp (optional)

  2. 02

    Build

    Describe the tool you wish existed. Your agent writes it right there — no repo, no build pipeline, no YAML.

    “Make a sprint board for us”

  3. 03

    Deploy

    Say “deploy to host0”. Your app is live on its own URL in seconds — private until you share it, open to anyone with the link when you want it to be. Rename the URL to something readable anytime.

    k7m2xq9rta.host0.app · live

What host0 does

Everything after your agent says done

One link for whatever it made, with sharing, a database, analytics and undo built in.

Share it like a doc, not like a deployment

Invite teammates by email, open it to anyone with the link, or put it on the web. Revoke access instantly. No IAM, no VPC, no security review to book.

Private until you share it

Every app goes live just for you. You decide who else gets in, and you can take it back at any time.

Any file your agent makes

HTML artifacts, whole sites, PDFs, Markdown, images and video. A file or a folder becomes a URL.

See who opens it Pro

Visitors, pages, referrers and countries on every app. No cookies, no script to add, no consent banner.

Undo a bad deploy in one click Pro

Every publish is a version. Say “roll back” to your agent or click Restore — any version from the last 30 days.

A database that just exists

Your agent declares collections in h0.json; everyone you share with reads and writes the same data. How it works

What it costs

$0

Start on the free plan — no card needed. Pro is $9/mo when you want the badge gone, bigger files and version history.

See pricing

The same hosting, straight from your browser — sign in on the page and the link is already in your dashboard.
